cues: In summary: first normal form, atomic values.
Second normal form only matters when the key has more than one column.
And keep the foreign keys, or the tables cannot be joined back together.
text: In summary: first normal form, atomic values. Second, no partial dependencies. Third, no transitive dependencies. Second normal form only matters when the key has more than one column. And keep the foreign keys, or the tables cannot be joined back together.
